message.name: ResolutionOfInvestigationV14
message.definition: Scope|The ResolutionOfInvestigation message is sent by a case assignee to a case creator/case assigner.|This message is used to inform of the resolution of a case, and optionally provides details about.|- the corrective action undertaken by the case assignee;|- information on the return where applicable.|Usage|The ResolutionOfInvestigation message is used by the case assignee to inform a case creator or case assigner about the resolution of a:|- request to cancel payment case;|The ResolutionOfInvestigation message covers one and only one case at a time. If the case assignee needs to communicate about several cases, then several Resolution Of Investigation messages must be sent.|The ResolutionOfInvestigation message provides:|- the final outcome of the case, whether positive or negative;|- optionally, the details of the corrective action undertaken by the case assignee and the information of the return.|Whenever the action of modifying or cancelling a payment results in funds being returned or reversed, an investigating agent may provide the details in the resolution related investigation component, to identify the return or reversal transaction. These details will facilitate the account reconciliations at the initiating bank and the intermediaries. It must be stressed that the return or reversal of funds is outside the scope of this Exceptions and Investigation service. The features given here is only meant to transmit the information of return or reversal when it is available through the resolution of the case.|The ResolutionOfInvestigation message must:|- be forwarded by all subsequent case assignee(s) until it reaches the case creator;|The ResolutionOfInvestigation message should be the sole message to respond to a cancellation request. Details of the underlying transactions and the related statuses for which the cancellation request has been issued may be provided in the CancellationDetails component.

rules.name: CancellationStatusReasonInformationRule
rules.text: If GroupCancellationStatus is present and is different from RejectedCancellationRequest (RJCR) or PendingCancellationRequest (PDCR), then CancellationStatusReasonInformation/AdditionalInformation is not allowed.

rules.name: NumberOfTransactionsPerCancellationStatusGuideline
rules.text: OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus should only be present if GroupCancellationStatus equals PACR.

rules.name: IdentificationOrProxyPresenceRule
rules.text: Identification must be present or Proxy must be present. Both may be present.

rules.name: IdentificationAndProxyGuideline
rules.text: If the account identification is not defined through a conventional identification such as an email address or a mobile number, then the proxy element should be used for the identification of the account.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgent is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent and InstructedReimbursementAgent must both be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to INDA or INGA, then ReimbursementAgent(s) and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then SettlementAccount and ClearingSystem are not allowed.

rules.name: SettlementMethodCoverAgentRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to COVE, then InstructedReimbursementAgent or InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: SettlementMethodClearingRule
rules.text: If SettlementMethod is equal to CLRG, then SettlementAccount and ReimbursementAgent(s) are not allowed.

rules.name: InstructingReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructingReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructingReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: InstructedReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If InstructedReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then InstructedReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: ThirdReimbursementAgentAccountRule
rules.text: If ThirdReimbursementAgentAccount is present, then ThirdReimbursementAgent must be present.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorTrueRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is true, then AmendmentInformationDetails must be present.

rules.name: AmendmentIndicatorFalseRule
rules.text: If AmendmentIndicator is false, then AmendmentInformationDetails is not allowed.

rules.name: RemittanceAmountAndTypeGuideline
rules.text: If Type/Code is equal to CREN, DUPA or REMI for RemittanceAmountAndType, RemittanceAmountAndType must not be repeated.

rules.name: CancellationStatusReasonInformationRule
rules.text: If PaymentInformationCancellationStatus is present and is different from RJCR (RejectedCancellationRequest) or PNCR (PendingCancellationRequest), then CancellationStatusReasonInformation/AdditionalInformation is not allowed.

rules.name: NumberOfTransactionsPerCancellationStatusGuideline
rules.text: OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus/NumberOfTransactionsPerStatus should only be present if GroupCancellationStatus equals PACR (PartialCancellationRequest).

rules.name: PaymentInformationOrTransactionResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

rules.name: GroupOrPaymentInformationResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

rules.name: GroupOrInitiationTransactionResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

rules.name: GroupOrInterbankTransactionResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus level, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: PartialOrRejectedCancellationRule
rules.text: If Status/Confirmation is present and equal to PECR or RJCR then CancellationDetails must be present.

rules.name: MessageOrGroupResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

rules.name: MessageOrPaymentInformationResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

rules.name: MessageOrInitiationTransactionResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.

rules.name: MessageOrInterbankTransactionResolvedCaseRule
rules.text: ResolvedCase may be present at either ResolvedCase, OriginalGroupInformationAndStatus, OriginalPaymentInformationAndStatus or TransactionInformationAndStatus level.
